Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixed active PvP Sprint protection. The active Sprint buff is a permanent toggle without a useful duration, so Seiton now uses exact buff presence and blocks repeat presses before direct hotbar execution plus at both native action boundaries. An alternate ordinary-Sprint carrier is accepted only when the game resolves it exactly to PvP Sprint. Other actions still end Sprint normally; Smart Sprint and all other helpers are unchanged. Live in-game confirmation remains separate from build checks.
